description:
Title: Luxury Airplane

You produce airplanes.
While the base model is always the same, your customer likes to pimp their airplane with fancy interior.
You let them decide between a number of 5 different bars, the number of seats, their color, and the amount of water in the toilets of their plane (you can come up with additional stuff).
After you received the specifications you send the requirements to different teams to manufacture the parts.
E.g. manufacturing the vodka bar is done by the Russian team, the whiskey bar is manufactured by an Irish team.
After receiving the individual bits and pieces, the interior of the plane is assembled, and the plane is sent on a test flight.
During the flight you create a test protocol which is sent to you and the customer.
The plane is delivered to the customer, which has to confirm.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_LuxuryAirplane"
                  targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/luxury-airplane">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Specifications" name="Airplane specifications"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Requirements" name="Manufacturing requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Parts" name="Manufactured parts"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TestProtocol" name="Test protocol"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Delivery" name="Plane delivery"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Confirmation" name="Delivery confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LuxuryAirplane">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Producer" name="Airplane producer" processRef="Process_Producer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ManufacturingTeams" name="Manufacturing teams" processRef="Process_ManufacturingTeams"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Specifications" name="Send specifications"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendSpecifications" targetRef="Start_ReceiveRequirements"
                      messageRef="Message_Specifications"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Requirements" name="Send manufacturing requirements"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Start_Manufacturing"
                      messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Parts" name="Return manufactured parts"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendParts" targetRef="Task_ReceiveParts"
                      messageRef="Message_Parts"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TestProtocol" name="Send test protocol to customer"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendTestProtocol" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTestProtocol"
                      messageRef="Message_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Delivery" name="Deliver plane"
                      sourceRef="Task_DeliverPlane" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDelivery"
                      messageRef="Message_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Send delivery confirmation"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Event_ReceiveConfirmation"
                      messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Specify and receive luxury airplane" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Begin customization"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectBar" name="Choose one of five bar options"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SpecifyInterior" name="Specify seat count, color, and toilet water amount"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSpecifications" name="Send specifications" messageRef="Message_Specifications"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveTestProtocol" name="Receive test protocol" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDelivery" name="Receive plane delivery" messageRef="Message_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Confirm delivery" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer" name="Delivery confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_SelectBar"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_SelectBar" targetRef="Task_SpecifyInterior"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_SpecifyInterior" targetRef="Task_SendSpecifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_SendSpecifications" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveTestProtocol" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDelivery" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_7" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="End_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Producer" name="Produce luxury airplane" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ReceiveRequirements" name="Specifications received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Specifications" messageRef="Message_Specifications"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequirements" name="Send requirements to different manufacturing teams" messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveParts" name="Receive individual parts" messageRef="Message_Parts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleInterior" name="Assemble airplane interior"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_TestSplit" name="Begin test flight and protocol work"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestFlight" name="Conduct test flight"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateTestProtocol" name="Create test protocol during the flight"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_TestJoin" name="Test flight and protocol work complete"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTestProtocol" name="Send test protocol to producer and customer" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DeliverPlane" name="Deliver plane to customer" messageRef="Message_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Delivery confirmation received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Producer" name="Delivery confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_1" sourceRef="Start_ReceiveRequirements" targetRef="Task_SendRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_2" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Task_ReceiveParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveParts" targetRef="Task_AssembleInterior"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_4" sourceRef="Task_AssembleInterior" targetRef="Gateway_TestSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_5" sourceRef="Gateway_TestSplit" targetRef="Task_TestFlight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_6" sourceRef="Gateway_TestSplit" targetRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_7" sourceRef="Task_TestFlight" targetRef="Gateway_TestJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_8" sourceRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol" targetRef="Gateway_TestJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_9" sourceRef="Gateway_TestJoin" targetRef="Task_SendTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_10" sourceRef="Task_SendTestProtocol" targetRef="Task_DeliverPlane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_11" sourceRef="Task_DeliverPlane" targetRef="Event_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Producer_12" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="End_Producer"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ManufacturingTeams" name="Manufacture airplane parts" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Manufacturing" name="Manufacturing requirements received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Requirements" messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureParts" name="Manufacture required parts"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendParts" name="Send individual manufactured parts" messageRef="Message_Parts"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Manufacturing" name="Parts returned"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manufacturing_1" sourceRef="Start_Manufacturing" targetRef="Task_ManufactureParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manufacturing_2" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureParts" targetRef="Task_SendParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Manufacturing_3" sourceRef="Task_SendParts" targetRef="End_Manufacturing"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
